verdict.rationale: The npx installer writes editable skill files into your repo, and updates only arrive when you run `npx skills update` ("Nothing updates behind your back"), so a lead can gate when changes land. However, the now-documented plugin routes are the opposite: an always-current, read-only bundle that "updates itself by default" in Claude Code and "at startup" in Codex, and the evidence shows no explicit version pinning or lockfile mechanism. missing for 10: explicit version pinning or lockfile support, any way to pin or disable auto-update on the plugin install routes, independent or hands-on corroboration of controlled update behavior.
